item.name: Teacher
item.description: Teacher records and their education history.

description.content:
Create a teacher, with optional embedded education rows in the same
transaction. Added by hand: the framework generator drops this operation
because GET /teachers is registered on the same path after it and resets
the path's method map.
List, search, filter and paginate teachers.
Page size. Default 20. (This can only be one of 20,50,100)

Filter expression. Valid keys: `first_name`, `last_name`,
`teacher_code`, `status`. Operators: `eq` and `lk`. Examples:
`status eq ACTIVE`, `first_name lk ADA`,
`teacher_code eq TCH-2024-001`.

Quirk (intentional, spec criterion 33): `status eq ACTIVE` is
internally rewritten to an `in` filter and also matches `ON_LEAVE`
teachers. Valid `status` values are `ACTIVE`, `ON_LEAVE`,
`INACTIVE`.

Order clause. Valid columns: `id`, `first_name`, `last_name`,
`teacher_code`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. Direction must be
exactly `ASC` or `DESC`; anything else (e.g. `ASCENDING`, `;--`)
is rejected with 400 `E-4-CMD-DTO-002`. Defaults to `id`.
Boolean connector between filters. Default AND. (This can only be one of AND,OR)

Teacher detail including `educations[]` (an empty array when there is no
history). Added by hand: the framework generator drops this operation
because PUT /teachers/{id} is registered on the same path after it and
resets the path's method map.
Update a teacher. Guarded by the `updated_at` optimistic lock; a stale value is rejected with `E-4-CMD-DTO-007`.
Set the teacher's status to INACTIVE. Guarded by the `updated_at` optimistic lock.

framework generator drops this operation because DELETE on the same path

description.content:
Teacher record management (create, read, update, deactivate) plus owned
education-history rows.

This spec is the complete contract for the feature's 8 routes. It started
from the framework-generated document at `GET /swagger/swagger.yaml`, which
is incomplete: nexcommon's controller resets a path's method map on every
registration (`controller/http/param.go`), so a path carrying two methods
loses the earlier one. Three operations here (POST /teachers,
GET /teachers/{id}, PUT /teachers/{id}/educations/{eduId}) were therefore
authored by hand from the route table and DTOs; each carries a `description`
note saying so.

All routes are registered with nexcommon's `WhitelistValidator`, so no
token is required and no `securitySchemes` entry applies to them.
